camel_example: aliyun dms-enterprise SearchDatabase --region cn-hangzhou --SearchRange HAS_PERMSSION --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SearchKey testdb --SearchTarget SINGLE_DB --RealLoginUserUid 'example-string' --Tid 3000 --EnvType test --DbType MYSQL
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise search-database --tid 3000 --search-key testdb --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --env-type test --search-range HAS_PERMSSION --search-target SINGLE_DB --db-type MYSQL --real-login-user-uid example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchDatabase

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html operation to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The keyword to search for databases
parameters.help_zh: 搜索数据库名称的关键字
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The environment type of the database. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163309.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据库的环境类型，更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163309.html
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en:
The permission scope. Valid values:

HAS_PERMSSION: databases that you have permissions on.

OWNER: databases that you own.

MY_FOCUS: databases that you follow.

UNKNOWN: all databases
parameters.help_zh:
权限范围，取值如下：
HAS_PERMSSION：有权限的数据库
OWNER：我Owner的数据库
MY_FOCUS：我关注的数据库
UNKNOWN：不限
parameters.name: search_range

parameters.help_en:
The search target. Valid values:

DB: all databases, including physical and logical databases.

SINGLE_DB: physical databases.

LOGIC_DB: logical databases
parameters.help_zh:
搜索目标，取值如下：
DB：不限（不区分单库或逻辑库）
SINGLE_DB：单库
LOGIC_DB：逻辑库
parameters.name: search_target

parameters.help_en: The database engine type. For more information about the valid values, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198106.html
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en:
The method for sorting the query results. Valid values:

LAST_ACTIVE_TIME: sorts the results by the last active time.

DB_NAME: sorts the results by the database name
parameters.name: real_login_user_uid

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code that is returned if the request fails

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message that is returned if the request fails

CatalogName.description_en:
The name of the database catalog.

For PostgreSQL databases, the database name is returned
CatalogName.description_zh:
数据库目录名。
PG系列的数据库将显示数据库名

DatalinkName.description_en: The name of the database link for cross-database queries

DbaId.description_en: The ID of the database administrator (DBA) of the instance

Encoding.description_en: The character set that is used in the database

EnvType.description_en: The environment type of the instance. For more information, see [Instance environments]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163309.html）
EnvType.description_zh: 数据库的环境类型，更多信息，请参见[实例环境说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163309.html）

Host.description_en: The endpoint that is used to connect to the database
Host.description_zh: 数据库所在实例的连接地址

Logic.description_en:
Indicates whether the database is a logical database. Valid values:

true: The database is a logical database.

false: The database is not a logical database
Logic.description_zh:
是否逻辑库，取值：
true：是
false：否

OwnerIds.description_en: The IDs of the database owners

items.description_en: The ID of a database owner

OwnerNames.description_en: The nicknames of the database owners

items.description_en: The nickname of a database owner

Port.description_en: The port that is used to connect to the database
Port.description_zh: 数据库所在实例的端口

SearchName.description_en: The name that is used to search for the database

Sid.description_en: The system ID (SID) of the instance

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that meet the filter criteria
